verdict: Organic demand is strong; ad spend needs to stabilize before scale-up.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Google Ads spend has been erratic — 12 of 28 days ran at zero or near-zero, and this past week averaged just $24.43 per day, down 59% from the week before. At the same time, your Google Business Profile is showing real demand: 116 actions this period, including 35 calls and 45 direction requests, up 52% week-over-week — organic interest is holding while paid has pulled back. The immediate priority is resolving who owns lead intake: 43 opportunities were created in the system this period, but zero appointments were booked, which points to follow-up automations routing to a gap in coverage. Confirming an intake owner by August 31 is the unlock that makes any spend increase worthwhile, with heating campaigns and a full budget ramp scheduled for October 1.
